Try keeping the lights low and the response brief when she wakes - a quick reassurance and back to bed, no conversation, which helps her brain learn that 2am isn't worth staying up for. Night waking at 8 is less common than at younger ages but picks up again around stress or schedule changes, so worth a look at what's shifted lately.
